sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 149026 b"
sources.quote: HD 149026 b, also known as Smertrios, is an exoplanet, specifically a hot Jupiter, approximately 250 light-years from the Sun in the constellation of Hercules.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HD 149026. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
